Recursive path creation is requested for "a/b", i.e. a directory "b" nested below the existing directory "a".
rootDir()->entry("a/b") resolves to the still-present empty KZipFileEntry "b" (F) that is stored in directory "a", not in rootDir.

Replacement of the file entry with a directory: removeEntry(myEntry) is called on rootDir() although myEntry (empty file "b") belongs to directory "a"; the lookup by name "b" in rootDir fails, so nothing is erased, and the following delete myEntry frees F while directory "a" still references it - a stale entry is retained.

Duplicate-name handling: addEntry sees d->entries.value("b") still non-null (dangling pointer F) and deletes the newly created directory "b" (the object pointer e).
